entries.choice_handling_note: Permanent style feats use the shared Feat picker and advancement budget; wildcard style slots are chosen transiently whenever styles change and therefore are not persisted as one fixed archetype choice.

power_providers.label: Qinggong Ki Powers
power_providers.description: Optionally replace each listed Monk ability with one qualifying Ki power. The power picker enforces imported level and named prerequisites; costs spend the shared Ki pool.

choice_providers.label: Draconic Energy
choice_providers.description: Choose the permanent damage type used by Draconic Fury and related abilities.

resources.name: Draconic Fury
resources.description: Spend 1 ki point as a swift action to add the chosen energy damage to natural and unarmed attacks for a number of rounds equal to half the Monk level.

resources.name: Monastic Mount
resources.description: Spend 1 ki point to grant the adjacent mount temporary hit points equal to twice Monk level for 1 hour per level, together with currently unlocked mount benefits.

resources.name: Weapon Training
resources.description: Record the weapon group selected at 6th level and additional groups at 12th and 18th level.

resources.name: Calming Strike
resources.description: Daily uses equal Monk level. After an unarmed hit against incorporeal undead, spend a use to apply calm spirit on a failed Will save; a haunt is targeted by a touch attack instead.

resources.name: Spirit Sense
resources.description: Spend 1 ki point as a swift action to notice, locate, and distinguish living and undead creatures within 30 feet for rounds equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

resources.name: Yamaraj's Judgment
resources.description: Spend 1 ki point as a standard action to attempt the archetype's targeted dispel check against an effect imprisoning a soul. Spend 1 additional ki point for the optional +4 check bonus.

entries.choice_handling_note: Water is the archetype's fixed elemental focus. Wild talents use the shared Kineticist power/resource presentation and are restricted to Water options by the archetype rules.

choice_providers.label: Zen Archer Weapon Focus
choice_providers.description: Choose the bow type for the 2nd-level Weapon Focus bonus feat.
